findings.evidenceJa: なんだかね、なんて溜息をつく
findings.governingReading: Rin sighs with a resigned “what a thing” response to the cost of the battle.
findings.explanation: Wondering why invents a question or failure of understanding absent from her acceptance.

findings.highlight: As she says, I bet her words will come true.
findings.evidenceJa: それと同じように、遠坂の言葉はあっさりと実現するに違いない
findings.governingReading: Because Rin states the ambition so lightly, Shirou believes it will become reality with the same ease.
findings.explanation: As she says drops the parallel between her effortless declaration and his confidence in effortless fulfillment.
